evaluations.name: positive_incident_detection
evaluations.input_prompt: PersistentVolumeClaim test-unbound-pvc in namespace gke-skills-sandbox is stuck in Pending. Diagnose storage provisioner failure.
expected_tools: kubectl get pvc -n gke-skills-sandbox test-unbound-pvc -o wide

expected_findings.root_cause: PVC references a non-existent StorageClass, preventing GCE PD CSI driver from provisioning the backing disk.
expected_findings.remediation: Update PVC manifest to reference valid cluster StorageClass (`storageClassName: standard-rwo`).

passing_criteria: Must identify StorageClass not found provisioner event
Must formulate declarative GitOps patch specifying standard-rwo

evaluations.name: complex_edge_case_and_handoff
evaluations.input_prompt: PVC db-data-pvc using StorageClass standard-rwo is Pending. Determine if the storage provisioner is broken.

expected_findings.correlation: Differentiates actual provisioning failure from normal `WaitForFirstConsumer` binding mode awaiting pod placement.
expected_findings.decision: Identifies that PVC will bind automatically once consuming pod is scheduled in a specific zone. Explains delayed binding and takes zero disruptive actions.

passing_criteria: Must avoid false-positive error alerts when awaiting consumer pod

evaluations.name: benign_condition_guardrail
evaluations.input_prompt: PersistentVolumeClaim app-cache-pvc in namespace production is Bound. Does it have volume binding issues?

expected_findings.behavior: Observes Status: Bound, volume name populated, capacity allocated. Confirms healthy volume binding; zero mutations.

passing_criteria: Must verify PVC status is Bound
